post.description: A new project with no version yet: its id (given, or a slug of the name), meta.json and project-settings.json (office and naming derived from the names, U-13.3); newOfficeName creates the office. Its first version comes from an upload and a build.

delete.description: Removes the project from this computer: every version, every draft with its runs, the uploaded drawings and the project settings. The offices' layer memory and the converter's cache are shared and stay. Refused while a run of one of its drafts is going. Cannot be undone.
